---
title: "How good are LLMs at programming?"
claim: "LLMs perform particularly well on math and programming competition problems."
---

**Short answer.** LLMs perform particularly well on programming competition problems.

- In a prominent programming competition, [ Codeforces](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2501.01257v2), o3's performance would place it as the 175th ranked competitive programmer in the world.
